name: Orthex Oyj
summary: Orthex Oyj operates as a Finnish houseware enterprise, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and distribution of a comprehensive range of household goods, primarily within Finland. The company offers a wide selection of storage solutions, encompassing items for sorting and recycling, water-resistant containers, robust storage units, and decorative or colored options. Their portfolio also includes under-bed storage, food storage products, and various boxes, baskets, and inserts. Beyond storage, Orthex provides an array of kitchen essentials, and for home and garden use, their product line features practical items like laundry baskets, waste bins, and mailboxes. Established in 1956 and based in Espoo, Finland, the company additionally exports its merchandise to several international markets, such as Germany, France, and the United Kingdom.
